none.title: No disputes yet
none.body: Add the lines with discrepancies on an invoice to the dispute list; the disputes you send are tracked here.

filtered.title: No dispute with this invoice no

card.title: Dispute
card.unsent_one: {{n}} line on the dispute list, claim {{amount}}. Mark it once you have sent it to the carrier.
card.unsent_other: {{n}} lines on the dispute list, claim {{amount}}. Mark it once you have sent it to the carrier.
card.unsentNoPrice_one: {{n}} line on the dispute list. Mark it once you have sent it to the carrier.
card.unsentNoPrice_other: {{n}} lines on the dispute list. Mark it once you have sent it to the carrier.
card.nothingToSend: No lines on the dispute list to send.
card.hintPrepare: Accounting sends the dispute and records the outcome.
card.lockedLine: This line is in a dispute that was sent. Withdraw the dispute first to change its decision.
card.unsentAfterSend_one: {{n}} line on the list, not sent yet · {{amount}}
card.unsentAfterSend_other: {{n}} lines on the list, not sent yet · {{amount}}
card.unsentAfterSendNoPrice_one: {{n}} line on the list, not sent yet
card.unsentAfterSendNoPrice_other: {{n}} lines on the list, not sent yet

history.title: History
history.superseded: Round {{next}} sent in place of round {{n}}

send.title: Mark as sent
send.pendingLines_one: {{n}} line has a changed measurement or status but was not recalculated. Check it before sending.
send.pendingLines_other: {{n}} lines have a changed measurement or status but were not recalculated. Check them before sending.
send.resendIntro: This round closes; every line on the list with no money back yet is claimed again.

result.title: Record outcome
result.noPending: Every line already has an outcome.
result.errAmount: The amount must be above zero, no more than the claim and have at most two decimals.

revert.title: Cancel entry
revert.intro: The entry is not deleted; it stays in the history as cancelled. Its lines wait for an outcome again.
revert.introOld: The entry is not deleted; it stays in the history as cancelled. It belongs to an earlier round: its lines go back to the dispute list and are claimed again when you resend.

withdraw.title: Withdraw dispute
withdraw.intro: Its record stays in the history. The lines' decisions can be changed again.
withdraw.blocked: A credit note is recorded in this dispute. Cancel that entry first.

field.future: The date cannot be in the future.
field.beforeInvoice: The date cannot be before the invoice date.
field.beforeSent: The date cannot be before the dispute was sent.

errors.STALE: This dispute changed while you were looking at it; the latest version is loaded. Try again.
errors.DISPUTE_ACTIVE: This invoice already has a dispute that was sent; the latest version is loaded.
errors.NO_SENDABLE_LINES: No lines on the dispute list to send.
errors.LINE_NOT_PENDING: One of the selected lines already has an outcome; the latest version is loaded.
errors.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_CLAIM: The amount recovered cannot be more than the claim.
errors.HAS_RECOVERED_RESULTS: A credit note is recorded in this dispute. Cancel that entry first.
errors.SENT_ON_IN_FUTURE: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.RESULT_ON_IN_FUTURE: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.LINE_IN_DISPUTE: This line is in a dispute that was sent. Withdraw the dispute first to change its decision.
errors.INVOICE_HAS_DISPUTE: This invoice has a dispute that was sent. Withdraw the dispute before deleting it or changing its currency.
errors.RESULT_ON_BEFORE_SENT: The date cannot be before the dispute was sent.
errors.SELECTION_CHANGED: The dispute list changed in the meantime, so nothing was saved. Take the current dispute letter and send that one to the carrier.
errors.RESULT_LINES_RESENT: The lines of this entry were claimed again in a later round, so the entry cannot be cancelled.
errors.LINE_CHANGED: The decision on this line changed while you were looking at it. The current state is loaded; decide again.
